clips.description: RugPullFall: feet yanked out, drops straight onto back in ~0.4s, lands flat face-up and stays down. Use 0.75-2.0s (frames ~90-240 @120fps) as a hard fall-backward / headshot snap-back crumple.

BannanaPeelSlip: walks forward, feet slip out front, falls backward onto back (on ground ~3.5s), stays face-up. Use 1.75-4.0s (frames ~210-480) for leg-hit legs-out-from-under death or slip knockdown.

fall on face: small hop/stagger at 2.25-3.0s, then pitches forward onto hands and chest (face-down, head ~0.2 of height), stays down. Use 2.2-4.2s (frames ~265-505) as a stagger-then-fall-forward death.
bck flp twst fall: backward flip with twist that fails and lands on the ground face-up (~4.75s). Use 3.4-5.5s (frames ~410-660) as an airborne spin + hard landing for blown-up deaths.
bck flp twst fall (take 2): backward twisting flip, crashes to ground on side (~5.0s). Use 3.6-6.0s (frames ~430-720) as a thrown/spinning landing.
A stumbles into B: forward stumble 1.4 body-heights with a sway, stays on feet. Good hit-from-behind/push stagger forward.
Partner take of the same stumble: lurches forward 1.7 body-heights, recovers to standing.
360 smallStumble: small in-place stagger (head dips ~6%), recovers. Light stagger.
StumbleWalk: drunken stumbling walk, lurches and dips (head to 0.85) twice, stays up. Use for dazed/stunned stagger locomotion.
KickFlipStumble: after a kick-flip the actor stumbles and drops to a crouch/hands (head 0.47 at ~5.5s) then recovers ~6.5s. Use 4.7-6.8s as stumble-to-knee-and-recover.
duck to avoid flying object: two sharp ducks/cowers (head drops to ~0.5) and recovers. Non-lethal flinch from a nearby blast or thrown object.
limping, hurt right leg (post leg-hit locomotion). Same data as 139_19 "Walk Wounded Leg".
Limp: long limping walk (15.8s). Post leg-hit locomotion.
Painfulleftknee: long stylized walk favouring the left knee (39s). Post leg-hit locomotion.
Get Up Face Down: starts prone face-down, pushes up, standing by ~4.25s.
Get Up Face Down (take 2): prone face-down, standing by ~5.0s.
Get Up Laying on Side: starts on side, rolls to hands and knees, standing by ~6.0s.
Get Up Laying on Side (take 2): standing by ~6.75s.
Get Up From Ground Laying on Back: starts face-up, sits up, rolls over to a knee, standing by ~5.25s.
Get Up From Ground Laying on Back (take 2): standing by ~4.5s.
laying down, getting up (index text) = "Get Up From Ground" in subject 139 naming: starts face-down, standing by ~3.5s (fastest face-down get-up).
Get Up From Ground (take 2): starts face-down, standing by ~5.25s.
Get Up From Ground Laying on Back: starts on back/side, standing by ~4.5s, ends in a careful ready pose.
Get up from floor: starts lying face-up, slow get-up, standing by ~10s (elderly/slow style).
Lies down (on ground 2.5s, face-up) then later gets up (standing ~14.3s). The 0.8-3.0s lie-down segment works as a slow controlled collapse onto the back.
Get up from floor: starts face-up, standing by ~10.5s (slow).
Lay down and get up: goes down via kneel (head 0.4 at 2s) onto back (4.0s), lies until 10.5s, stands by ~13.3s. 0.8-4.2s = kneel-then-collapse-onto-back.
Getting up from laying down: starts on side, standing by ~10s.
Laying down and getting up (29s): on ground 6.75-12.75s, standing by ~19.75s.

notes: CMU has no scripted deaths; these are falls, stumbles, limps and get-ups. Time ranges exclude the T-pose frame (frame = t*120+1). Searched index for fall/die/death/stumble/get up/hit/shot/push/knock.
